items.source: the cache
items.translation: 缓存

items.source: Customizes the CacheSpec for the build cache using the given action.
items.translation: 使用给定的 action` 为构建缓存自定义 CacheSpec。

items.source: Customizes the CacheSpec for the build temporary workspace using the given action.
items.translation: 使用给定的 action` 为构建临时工作区自定义 CacheSpec。

items.source: Customizes the CacheSpec for the launch cache using the given action.
items.translation: 使用给定的 action` 为启动缓存自定义 CacheSpec。

items.source: action - the action
items.translation: action - 操作

items.source: Returns the name of the image that will be built. When null, the name will be derived from the Project's name and version.
items.translation: 返回将要构建的图像名称。当为 null` 时，名称将从 Project's name 和 version 派生。

items.source: Returns the date that will be used as the Created date of the image. When null, a fixed date that enables build reproducibility will be used.
items.translation: 返回将用作图像 Created` 日期的日期。当为null`时，将使用一个固定的日期以确保构建的可重现性。

items.source: Configures the Docker connection using the given action.
items.translation: 使用给定的 action 配置 Docker 连接。

items.source: Returns the builder that will be used to build the image. When null, the default builder will be used.
items.translation: 返回用于构建镜像的构建器。当为 null` 时，将使用默认构建器。

items.source: Returns the run image that will be included in the built image. When null, the run image bundled with the builder will be used.
items.translation: 返回将包含在构建镜像中的运行镜像。当为`null`时，将使用构建器捆绑的运行镜像。

items.source: Returns the directory that contains application content in the image. When null, a default location will be used.
items.translation: 返回包含镜像中应用程序内容的目录。当为 null` 时，将使用默认位置。

items.source: Returns the platform (os/architecture/variant) that will be used for all pulled images. When null, the system will choose a platform based on the host operating system and architecture.
items.translation: 返回用于所有拉取镜像的平台（操作系统/架构/变体）。当为`null`时，系统将根据主机操作系统和架构选择平台。

items.source: Returns the property for the archive file from which the image will be built.
items.translation: 返回用于构建镜像的归档文件的属性。

items.source:
Returns the volume bindings that will be mounted to the container when building the
image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将挂载到容器的卷绑定。

items.source: Returns the build cache that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的构建缓存。

items.source: Returns the buildpacks that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的构建包。

items.source: Returns the build temporary workspace that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的构建临时工作区。

items.source: Returns whether caches should be cleaned before packaging.
items.translation: 返回在打包之前是否应清理缓存。

items.source: Returns the Docker configuration the builder will use.
items.translation: 返回构建器将使用的 Docker 配置。

items.source: Returns the environment that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的环境。

items.source: Returns the launch cache that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的启动缓存。

items.source: Returns the network the build container will connect to.
items.translation: 返回构建容器将连接的网路。

items.source: Whether the built image should be pushed to a registry.
items.translation: 是否应将构建的镜像推送到注册表。

items.source: Returns image pull policy that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 返回构建镜像时将使用的镜像拉取策略。

items.source: Returns the security options that will be applied to the builder container.
items.translation: 返回将应用于构建器容器的安全选项。

items.source: Returns the tags that will be created for the built image.
items.translation: 返回为构建的镜像创建的标签。

items.source: Whether to treat the builder as trusted.
items.translation: 是否将构建器视为可信。

items.source: Whether verbose logging should be enabled while building the image.
items.translation: 构建镜像时是否启用详细日志记录。

items.source: Sets image pull policy that will be used when building the image.
items.translation: 设置构建镜像时将使用的镜像拉取策略。

items.source: pullPolicy - the pull policy to use
items.translation: pullPolicy - 要使用的拉取策略
